title: Site-Crew Credit Against the In-Place Home Resale Vacant-Home Check
content:
**Memo — site crew already on the lot.** Where an In-Place Home Resale package charges for the vacant-home check, the month's check charge carries a site-crew credit that follows the seller's enrolled Community Rules & Site Care plan, the community on the seller's Home-Site Lease and the month charged:

- a plan that includes snow removal, for a home at Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows, in a month that is one of the package's winterization months (November through March on every package), credits 20.00;
- a plan that includes mowing, for a home in any other community or in a month outside the winterization months, credits 10.00;
- any other plan, community or month credits nothing.

The credit is subtracted from the month's visit charge as multiplied by any part-month rate; the remainder is never taken below zero and is rounded half up to the cent only at that final step.

**What is read.** Whether the Community Rules & Site Care plan in enrolled status on the seller's site includes snow removal, and whether it includes mowing; the community the Home-Site Lease places the home in; and the month charged.

## Truth table

| Plan includes snow removal | Plan includes mowing | Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows | Winterization month | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | yes | yes | 20.00 |
| yes | yes | yes | no | 10.00 |
| yes | no | yes | no | 0.00 |
| yes or no | yes | no | yes or no | 10.00 |
| yes | no | no | yes or no | 0.00 |
| no | yes | yes | yes | 0.00 |
| no | yes | yes | no | 10.00 |
| no | no | any | any | 0.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Visit charge 140.00 at a rate of one, snow-removal plan at Cedar Hollow in January: 140.00 less 20.00 is 120.00.
- Visit charge 18.00 at a part-month rate of 0.5 (9.00), mowing plan at Saguaro Vista: 9.00 less 10.00 is below zero, so the charge is 0.00.
